messages:
sara_pd: Quick sync re: Azure Marketplace + SI hardware partner (NimbleSys). They need a combined evidence bundle for onboarding: SOC2 or bridge letter, pen test executive summary, HSM vendor attestation, and a short supply-chain questionnaire. We're aiming for listing by May 10.

ben_c: Timeline noted. Who owns getting the NimbleSys HSM attestation? I can try but might need contact details from the integration PM.

marcos_partners: I have partner contact (ana@nimble.dev). I'll intro and request their standard HSM attestation + vendor SOC. Expect 5-7 day turnaround.

ben_c: Great. Also need clarity: does Azure require the vendor-signed bridge letter or is our SOC2 enough? Last time some listings wanted explicit vendor attestation.

legal_bot: Per last checklist: Azure sometimes requires a vendor attestation (cover letter) in addition to SOC2. Recommend we prepare both: 1) Redwood-signed bridge letter and 2) request vendor attestation from NimbleSys. I'll draft template.

marketing: Heads-up: joint announcement planned after listing goes live. We'll need a short compliant blurb about security posture approved by Legal. Save a slot in the May 15 release calendar.

infra_bot: FYI I can provision a secure evidence bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/marketplace/azure/nimblesys/ with presign-policy marketplace-evidence-presign-v2. Default TTL 3 days for reviewers, extendable by Legal.

marcos_partners: Thanks infra_bot. Please enable object versioning and server-side encryption. We'll upload artifacts there.

infra_bot: Versioning + SSE-KMS enabled. IAM: added a restricted reviewer role (marketplace-reviewer) for partner and cloud marketplace auditors.

sara_pd: Checklist from product side: 1) SOC2 full report (most recent) or bridge letter 2) 3P pen-test exec summary (redacted) 3) HSM attestation from NimbleSys 4) Supply-chain questionnaire 5) Signed NDA between NimbleSys and listing team. Who's collecting the NDA?

marcos_partners: I'll get the NDA signed on partner side. Ben, can you do the internal signature flow?

ben_c: Yep, I'll route to Legal for internal sign-off today.

legal_bot: Drafting NDA + attestation template. Will paste attestation template snippet here when ready.

marketplace-bot: marketplace-bot: Created evidence folder and initial ACLs. Presign template: max_ttl=259200s, partner_template=https://internal.docs/presigns/azure-nimble-template.

ben_c: Uploaded a stub: supply_chain_questionnaire_v1.xlsx to s3://redwood-evidence/marketplace/azure/nimblesys/ (private). Will flag rows that require partner input.

marcos_partners: Intro email sent to ana@nimble.dev for HSM attestation + pen test summary. Requested return by 2026-05-02 to meet May 10 listing.

sara_pd: If NimbleSys can't get us the pen-test summary in time, we can accept a notarized executive summary + commitment to provide redacted report within 30 days. Legal, confirm that's acceptable?

legal_bot: Acceptable as fallback. Must include: statement of scope, testing dates, high-level severity distribution, and confirmation redactions were applied (no customer or exploit code). We'll require an attestation signature and date.

infra_bot: Note for ops: we'll create temporary presigned URLs for external reviewers, but all external share must be gated behind NDA. Use command:

```bash
# create presign (example)
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/marketplace/azure/nimblesys/SOC2_Report_2026.pdf --expires-in 259200
```

sara_pd: Can someone confirm export ownership so I can mark the partner release checklist as ready? Need owners for each artifact: SOC2 (ben_c), pen test (marcos_partners), HSM attestation (marcos_partners), questionnaire (sara_pd), NDA (ben_c).

marcos_partners: Assigned in the CSV and locked. Will upload HSM attestation when received.

marketplace-bot: Artifact uploaded: supply_chain_questionnaire_v1.xlsx by ben_c to s3://redwood-evidence/marketplace/azure/nimblesys/supply_chain_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (presigned_url=https://presigned.example/nimblesys/questionnaire?sig=REDACTED, expires=259200)

marketing: Once Legal finalizes the attestation wording, I'll prep the announcement copy. Keep me looped in; we'll need approved security bullet points only.

ben_c: Legal signed NDA and attestation templates posted to the evidence folder. Ticket MKP-4902 created to track all items.

sara_pd: Perfect. Final action items: Marcos to upload HSM attestation by 2026-05-02, Ben to confirm SOC2 or bridge letter by 2026-05-03, infra to enable presign sweep and TTL enforcement, Marketing & Legal to approve announcement. Will reconvene in 48h if any items pending.

marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled: marketplace-bot will remind this thread in 48h to confirm outstanding artifacts.
